about: SISO's UI packages and the pieces inside them, with every version, newest first. ECOSYSTEM adds a version each time a piece changes; code facts come from git (Agent Base's packages/). Screenshots: app/public/a/pkg/ (local). v8 (10 Oct): one base, the UI Hub app, with every v7 piece on its primitives; v7 stays at :8853 as the reference.

packages.name: Side nav
packages.about: The side nav every SISO app wears: the rim, the header, search, the rows, the foot.

versions.note: The open category lists its subcategories under it (Shaan: "broken up and subcategories more"): the ten biggest and the one you're in, then +N more; the chosen one lights up. Exact copies of other libraries' parts are left out of the counts.

UI's list follows its top tab (Shaan: "what pages go what … from first principles … use case wise"). Components by the job a piece does, 11 jobs, each opening its kinds; Sites by section; Apps by screen, flow and layout; Looks by what moves and what sits behind; Projects by what each still needs picked. Libraries, authors, discover, tools and the agents' page sit under The library. Industries' screens moved to the Industries core; Bookmarks is the Saved pill only.

The App Factory's: the name at the top says App Factory, with the core you're in under it, and opens every core in his groups (Know who, Build with, Judge, Make); each core is its own list. The icons move again, the chosen row wears v7's ring, and the edge no longer lights up.

One base: the UI Hub app's own side nav, flat on the frame with no box around it, with its drill-in (the way back centred over the list, "‹ Components") and All industries. The top tabs change its list, and it slides across. From v7: the edge resizes, the fold sits on the header's right, labels are 12 letters at most, and the version sits at the foot.

The back arrow sits beside the title, as on 21st.dev; search runs full width on its own; the edge resizes from the border; help and the version are one card; labels are 12 letters at most; levels slide across.
The fold moves to the header's right; every level opens on its own Home or Overview.
Agent Base's header; the ecosystem becomes a side nav view; full-width search; drag the edge to resize; the version at the foot; SISO's greys.
A header card for wherever you are; the ecosystem opens from the orb; the Browser's outline for selection; the rim lights near the pointer; a ? at the foot.
The rim is locked; no four tools; flat selection like HALO's; toggles and ticks; light and dark.
No icon rail: the side nav goes in and out of hubs; search becomes an icon; glass hover.
The Halo rim wraps the whole side nav, Arc-style; a colour and orb per app; HALO's four tools; a breadcrumb top bar.
The first cut: an icon rail beside the nav, divider lines, his name at the foot.
